description: This file defines a generic Result class for handling success or failure outcomes, including associated classes Ok and Err, with methods for mapping and folding over the result.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A sealed class representing either a successful result (Ok) or an error result (Err), with utility methods for handling these outcomes.

classes.name: Ok
classes.description: A class representing a successful result with an associated value.

classes.name: Err
classes.description: A class representing an error result with an associated error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms the contained Ok value if present, or leaves the Err unchanged.

methods.name: mapErr
methods.description: Transforms the contained Err error if present, or leaves the Ok value unchanged.

methods.name: fold
methods.description: Applies onOk or onErr functions to the contained value or error, respectively, to produce a single output.

calls: final value = this as Ok<T, E>.value
final error = this as Err<T, E>.error
